label: A profile is admissible exactly when no member requires the lack of members
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the constitutive reading of the admissible intrinsic profile family. A set of real determinations is admissible exactly when it is exclusion-free: no member d and subset S of the set are such that d requires the lack of S. Every inadmissibility is then attributed to some member's requirement of a lack. It is neutral about purity. Because exclusion-freedom is inherited by subsets, it makes the family downward closed and admits the empty profile, so it excludes both irreducibly holistic prohibitions (no member's requirement accounts for them) and requirements of presence (a member that needs another alongside it, or a family that requires a determination in every profile). It does not identify the primitive family with the defined notion; it states that they coincide.
